title: Chapter 384 Red Team Surrenders
content:
Chapter 384 Red Team Surrenders

There are still nearly 2,000 people on the purple side. Although the generals cannot resist the boss's attack, they are outnumbered!

Under the leadership of Wang Shuo, they continue to attack the Earth Mother Worm Emperor.

Under the attack of the red side's generals, the Earth Mother Worm Emperor has been seriously injured. Wang Shuo is completely picking up the leak.

A few minutes later, the Earth Mother Worm Emperor was killed by Wang Shuo at the right time.

Wang Shuo didn't even look at it, and quickly picked up a bead dropped by the Earth Mother Worm Emperor.

There were so many people and eyes, Wang Shuo didn't look at it much.

After cleaning up the battlefield, Wang Shuo led everyone to the enemy's main base.

This battle not only wiped out the Earth Mother Worm's nest and killed the Earth Mother Worm Emperor, but also killed the enemy's commander and destroyed the main force of the red side.

A great victory.

Wang Shuo was in a very good mood.

After counting the spoils, Wang Shuo got five Shura Orders.

The other Shura Orders were taken by other generals, and Wang Shuo could only pretend not to know.

Then, the army set out towards the Red Team base.

As the main force of the Red Team was destroyed, the commander was killed.

Wang Shuo began to persuade the remaining members of the Red Team to surrender.

"Everyone on the Red Team, surrender!"

Wang Shuo lifted the head of the Red Team commander and threw it into the city wall.

Seeing this, the remaining members of the Red Team did not resist stubbornly.

It was only a matter of time to break through the main base.

If they surrendered at this time, they would still have the opportunity to participate in the next confrontation. If they were killed, it would be too late to regret.

As Wang Shuo broke through the stone pillars of the Red Team's main base.

A voice sounded.

[You won the battle. Get the qualification to enter the third floor of the Shura General Tower. ]

The scene in front of Wang Shuo turned and came to a secret room.

This place is similar to the Dizang Pavilion on the first floor.

The difference is that this place is more like a library.

The books inside are as vast as the sea of smoke.

Wang Shuo saw the scene in front of him and wondered in his heart, how can I pass this third level?

Is it a reading contest?

Wang Shuo didn't wait too long.

[The requirement to pass the third level is to practice a formation, martial arts or skills to a high level. ]

So simple?

Wang Shuo then began to browse the entire library.

Not simple, really not simple.

In the library, Wang Shuo also met many generals.

Some of them have gray hair, and some are in their prime.

Some are crazy, and some are impatient!

Wang Shuo walked around all day, but he didn't finish the entire library.

If you want to learn every kind of martial arts here, I'm afraid it will take a lifetime? !

Outside the library, there is also a small town with some living facilities, and the same Shura coins are used.

The difference is that by studying in the library, you can get Shura coins, 100 coins a day, which can basically meet a person's daily living needs.

This is an infinite cycle!

Wang Shuo ate something casually and continued to enter the library.

This time he chose a military book and a set of formations.

The military book can help him improve his lack of experience in commanding troops, and when the formations are practiced to a high level, he can leave this place.

In the following days, Wang Shuo lived a monotonous and repetitive life like other generals.

He practiced battle formations, martial arts, and skills, and then read some war cases, as well as some history of the Shenwu Empire and the Vlandia Continent.
